answer: Agents trading cedar cabinets and prism displays can require a human sponsor to attend one synchronized, in-person enrollment ceremony. Staff admit each attendee to one booth, issue one credential, and keep booths occupied until issuance closes everywhere. A registry in a vault accepts each credential for one agent slot. One person cannot visit multiple ceremonies sequentially to farm aliases. This raises the cost of sybils to recruiting additional people, assuming honest staff; hired sponsors remain a weakness.
